text: Traffic for trailers and semi-trailers is prohibited on the Nakerala Pass and the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.

Due to snowfall, the movement of trailers and semi-trailers is temporarily prohibited on the km39-km60 (Nakerala Pass) section of the Kutaisi (Motsameta)-Tkibuli-Ambrolauri road of intra-state importance and on the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.
The information is released by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia. According to the same source, the movement of other types of vehicles is free.
